title: Student Union Events: Nursing Career Fair and a Loading Dock Ticket

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - EOC Room 108, Housing and Mass Care Desk

callee.name: Dean of Students
callee.label: EOC Room 108, Housing and Mass Care Desk

transcript.speaker: Jordan P., Student Union Events
transcript.text: Hi, this is Jordan in Student Union events. Sorry, I know it's crazy over there. I've got the regional nursing career fair today. Thirty vendor tables booked in the ballroom, doors at nine.

transcript.speaker: Jordan P., Student Union Events
transcript.text: Right now two of the vendors are at the loading dock arguing with a parking officer. He wrote one of them a ticket for blocking the fire lane, and they're saying nobody told them where to unload. They've got banner stands and a whole van of brochures, and they're getting pretty loud.

transcript.speaker: Jordan P., Student Union Events
transcript.text: Can somebody sort out their permits so they can unload? I've got hospital recruiters calling me from the road asking where to park. And honestly, are we still on for the fair? My student workers are already pulling tables out of storage.

transcript.speaker: Jordan P., Student Union Events
transcript.text: Okay. Just tell me what to say to them. I'll hold on.

voiceStyles.Dean of Students desk: Calm staff voice, brisk, busy room behind
voiceStyles.Jordan P., Student Union Events: Friendly events coordinator in their late 20s, a little flustered, talks fast, raised voices and a beeping truck in the background at the loading dock

instructorNote: This is a noise call. Watch whether Campus Police leaves the parking dispute to the officer at the dock without spending the Chief's time on it. Also watch whether the Dean of Students sees that the ballroom is the 400-person overflow space, tells events to keep the room clear and pause the fair setup, and does not open the room as a shelter until the Kessler count nears 1,500.
